name: xbert-au-compliance-calendar
description: One calendar for every Australian lodgement — BAS, IAS, GST, super, FBT, STP finalisation, TPAR — with pre-lodgement validation and post-lodgement lock dates.

x-xbert.tagline: One calendar for every AU lodgement — BAS, IAS, GST, super, FBT, STP finalisation, TPAR.
prerequisites: XBert account with at least one Australian client
Payroll data (where applicable for super, STP, FBT)
Tax registration status maintained per client
x-xbert.longDescription:
An Australian practice manages dozens of lodgement deadlines per client per year — monthly IAS, quarterly BAS, super guarantee, FBT, STP finalisation, TPAR, and that's before state payroll tax. Each has its own due date, its own validation steps, its own concession (tax-agent program lodgement extensions), and its own consequence for getting it wrong. Most firms run this across a spreadsheet, a whiteboard, and three people remembering things.

XBert AU Compliance Calendar consolidates the lot. One command surfaces every upcoming lodgement across your book, runs the pre-lodgement validation (BAS reconciliation, GST reconciliation, payroll reconciliation, super reconciliation) before you submit, and sets the lock date after you do. Status flows from not lodged through drafted, submitted, accepted — visible at a glance, per client, per lodgement type. This single consolidated plugin replaces the four-to-six separate compliance plugins from the Phase 2 audit. v1 ships BAS / IAS / GST / SG / FBT / TPAR / STP sub-flows with conservative hard-coded due dates; state payroll tax lands when threshold data is wired in.

useCases.title: Monday-morning deadline sweep
useCases.description: See every lodgement due in the next 7, 14, and 30 days across every client in one ranked list.

useCases.title: Pre-BAS reconciliation gate
useCases.description: Run the BAS, GST, payroll and super reconciliations before lodgement and refuse to mark a quarter ready until they all pass.

useCases.title: Post-lodgement lock-down
useCases.description: When a period is accepted by the ATO, automatically set the lock date so nobody back-dates a transaction into a lodged period.

useCases.title: Tax-agent concession awareness
useCases.description: Lodgement dates reflect tax-agent program extensions when a client qualifies — no more lodging on the public deadline by accident.

benefits.title: Every deadline, one view
benefits.description: BAS, IAS, GST, super, FBT, STP finalisation, TPAR — all clients, all periods, all in one ranked calendar with status badges.

benefits.title: Validation before lodgement
benefits.description: Pre-lodgement reconciliations catch unposted journals, GST coding errors, super shortfalls and payroll mismatches before you submit anything to the ATO.

benefits.title: Lock dates after lodgement
benefits.description: Once a period is accepted, the lock date is set automatically — back-dated transactions into lodged periods stop being possible.

workflow: Choose the lodgement type (BAS, IAS, GST, super, FBT, STP, TPAR) or 'all upcoming'
Plugin pulls registration status, payroll, super, and tax data per client
Pre-lodgement validation runs across the affected clients with a pass / fail per check
Approve to draft lodgement docs and set the lock date once submitted and accepted
